guide.summary: Customer-specific OAuth integration is documented. Each customer authorizes separately, and the token reaches only pages the customer selects in the page picker and their children. Read content is the applicable capability for reading titles and content. Other customer workspaces require a public integration, and the snapshots do not document whether a public integration needs review or admin approval before other workspaces can install it.

findings.title: Each customer authorizes via OAuth and selects pages in the page picker
findings.detail: Each user follows the OAuth flow separately. Notion shows the connection capabilities, the user selects pages through the page picker, and the app exchanges the returned code for a user-tied access token. Only that user can interact with the connection in their workspace.

findings.title: Read content capability for reading page titles and content
findings.detail: The Read content capability lets the connection read existing content. Page retrieval requires it and returns 403 without it. Read content does not grant create or update access, which matches the no-write requirement.
findings.appliesWhen: Reading titles and content of shared pages

evidence.quote: Read content : This capability gives a connection access to read existing content in a Notion workspace. For example, a connection with only this capability is able to call Retrieve
Requirements Your connection must have read content capabilities on the target page in order to call this endpoint. To update your connection’s capabilities, navigate to the Developer portal , select
​ Errors The connection needs read content capabilities . Missing capabilities return 403 . A missing page or missing access returns 404 .

steps.title: Exchange the authorization code for an access token
steps.detail: Send the code from the redirect to the token endpoint using HTTP Basic authentication with CLIENT_ID:CLIENT_SECRET. Include grant_type authorization_code, the code, and the same redirect_uri used in authorization. Store the returned access_token, refresh_token and bot_id.
steps.doneWhen: The token endpoint returns access_token, refresh_token, bot_id, workspace_id and owner, and the tokens are stored securely.

steps.title: Read a shared page's properties and markdown content with the customer's token
steps.detail: Using the customer's access_token, retrieve a page the customer selected in the page picker. Read the page object for title and other properties, then retrieve markdown for content. steps.doneWhen: Page retrieval returns 200 with the page object and its title property, and markdown retrieval returns the page content, using the customer's token.
